critical_code_review_comments: routers/users.py privacy defaults map (DEFAULT_PRIVACY with all True) is solid; _build_card applies privacy.profile_visible!=False AND searchable!=False for vehicle filtering — owner-only override is correct.

routers/services.py uses Haversine properly and prefilters radius on server side. Slug uniqueness via _unique_slug prevents collisions. /services PUT correctly enforces owner_id OR admin/moderator role.

routers/events.py reuses haversine + _slug from services.py (good DRY). join enforces max_participants via len() check before $addToSet — single pre-check is fine but race condition possible with very heavy concurrent joins (acceptable for current scale). date_start upcoming filter uses ISO-date string comparison which works for both YYYY-MM-DD and full ISO datetimes.
routers/search.py asyncio.gather with return_exceptions=True is robust — a single subquery failure won't take down the whole response. Counts dict is computed lazily from response keys.

users.py /users/{slug_or_id}/card does not 403 when profile_public=false but show_garage_card=true — intentional design (standalone card can be shown even when full profile is private). Verified this matches the privacy matrix in the spec.
events.py /events?upcoming filter uses $gte today — good. But an event with date_start='2026-05-04T15:00:00Z' on the same day will still match since ISO strings compare correctly. Good.

services.py ServiceIn.category default='workshop' but CATEGORIES also includes 'track' which is not in the problem statement list (workshop|dealer|detailing|tuning|rental|tow|other). 'track' should probably live in events EVENT_TYPES only — low priority, just a minor categorization suggestion.
